scores.paired_delta_convention: candidate minus reference (negative means shorter); ratios use same-batch medians

host_scheduling.scope: Per-vCPU /proc counters from thread creation to QMP stop after UART. They include startup and post-UART boundary, not kernel-only time. Concurrent vCPU delays overlap and should not be summed into wall time. No affinity is set.

affinity_experiment.notes: Both arms start -S. Measure from just before QMP cont through the existing UART completion waiter. The separately shown startup–UART period includes setup. In the pinned arm only the four verified vCPU TIDs of this process are bound, index i to WSL CPU i; no other thread is changed. Per-thread scheduler-counter deltas bracket cont to stop and include the post-UART QMP boundary. Overlapping delays cannot be summed into wall time.

decision: Keep both Q-loading variants experimental. The paired gain over two-step FLW reversed in the second independent batch. For the separate temporary CPU pinning diagnostic, cont-to-UART improved slightly in both batches but the full launch and slowest run did not improve consistently; keep normal scheduling.
